rule: verified requires one or more existing proof paths containing runtime output; design and local simulation do not satisfy platform execution

ncp-aai.requirement: Model-backed ReAct/tool/prompt evaluation on a held-out and adversarial set
NeMo Guardrails, NIM, Agent Toolkit and optimized inference lab evidence
Container deployment, load/failure profile, telemetry and rollback evidence
Usable human approval/intervention workflow with immutable audit linkage

aws-sap.requirement: Disposable multi-account governance and delegated-security evidence
Hybrid/network, private service access, data and key-control lab evidence
Measured failover and restore exercise against numeric RTO/RPO
Telemetry, deployment rollback, quota and cost-allocation evidence
Published SAP-C03 guide diff and replacement of provisional C02-only coverage

cka.requirement: Live kubeadm create/join/upgrade and control-plane troubleshooting evidence
Live scheduling, rollout, probes, configuration and autoscaling evidence
Live Service, DNS, CNI NetworkPolicy, Gateway and Ingress evidence
Live CSI, StorageClass, PV/PVC, topology and reclaim evidence
Varied unseen fault drills under the two-hour performance constraint

ncp-genl.requirement: Baseline, prompting and RAG comparison on held-out model evaluation
SFT/PEFT and preference-method model training with checkpoints and regressions
GPU profiler plus mixed-precision and distributed/parallelism experiment
Quantization/optimization and NIM/Triton serving load evidence
Human/calibrated judge, fairness, guardrail and monitoring evidence

ccsp.requirement: Scoped provider assurance and cryptographic validation report review
Federation, MFA, secrets/keys/certificates and IRM lifecycle lab
SAST/DAST/SCA, SBOM, signing and supply-chain verification evidence
Candidate-specific ISC2 experience or Associate pathway verification

google-pmle.requirement: BigQuery ML and managed API/AutoML baseline evidence
Vertex AI custom training/tuning, lineage and hardware-selection evidence
Parameterized Vertex/Kubeflow pipeline with validation, approval and conditional deployment
Batch and online endpoint, load, canary and rollback evidence
